book.name: YIPIRUW
book.title: Sukwudaal Maaj YIPIRUW Kristen Duw Takwak

content: Juw duw daya nyidim duw nak day tasakwudanaad yitaypika pris tidikikik. Adiy yitaypika pris yawiy kwurkwadanadiy Godak nuwukadiy duw takwa danik tikuw. Adiy yitaypika pris dayadiy Godak kwiyik jaavawa dayadiy vaal Godak kwiykwadanadiy.
Aw day duw tikuw, ap samasam ti maardanalik, alik day nuwukadiy duw takwak bwunak wukikwanadiy day mwiyir lakwu maarkuw, jawjaay yidaak.
Aw adiy yitaypika pris ap samasam ti maardanalik, alik day dayawa nuwukadiy duw taakw nakamwiyib vaal Godak kwiykwadanadiy.
Duw nak di dikim maa tasakw yitaypika pris tikir. Aw God di diki yitaypika pris tasakwukinaad tayir Aran-aam tasakwudil pik.
Atampik Jisas Krais di dikim tasakwu maa yitaypika pris tikir. Aw God a jaav kwurdil. Di wadid,
Niki nyi God Jisas Kraisak wadid,

content.text: “Min pris nyanyi nyanyi tikwanadimin Milkisitik kaytik.”

content: Jisas diki yawiy, kidi kupwaam kwadik.

Jisas duw tikuwmaa tasakw yitaypika pris tikir. Aw God di diki yitaypika pris tasakwukinaad tayir Aran-aam tasakwudil kidi kupwaam, di gaam sitaay, girataay, Godak bas sidid dim nyigil-dikik kiyakiyak. Di God mawul walil pik kwurik wukidalik, alik God diki maaj wukidil.
Aw li di God dikidi Nyan tikuw, kupwaraap sapwurapa jaav dikik yidiy. Adiy jaav dim kalivadaad God diki majib wukidikik.
Aw Jisas God diki majib wukidik, God ata waad, “Min bwu rivinadimin mwugiy-kimina ababa mina majib wukikidiy duw taakw day nyanyi kip yara tidakikik, min yitaypika pris Milkisatik kaytik tikuw.”
Gwur maa rav God diki maaj liki maaw mwiyir lakwu-lakwuk.
Nyan maaj samasam bwula-bwulak Jisas Kraisawa Milkisatik biraki pris yawiyik. Alim maa rav. Gwur mwiya kwasa kwasa lakwu-kwanadiygwur.

Aw gwur samasama nabiy Kristen tinadiygwur. Nyan wukibana gwur nuwukadiy duw takwak God diki maaj kaliva-kwanadiy. Aw gwur maa rav. Aw li gwurak nuwukadiy duw maa God dikidiy mwiya basa jaav kalivakwadiy. Gwur mwuny kikwanadiy kwasadiy nyanugw kaytik-adiygwur. Gwur mwiyir maa rav apa kamnaagw kikak.
Atampika duw taakw day ap ti maarkuw, kwula Kristen kaytik tinadiy. Aw day mwiyir akis lakwukwanadiy agwa jaav viyakita jaav tina, aw agwa jaav kupwarapa jaav tina.

Aw adiy ap tinadiy Kristen, day adiy apa kamnaagw kikwanadiy duw taakw kaytik tikuw, day God diki maaj mwiyir lakwukuw, a maaj nyanyi wukikuw, day mwiyir lakwukwanadiy agwa jaav viyakita jaav tina, aw agwa jaav kupwarapa jaav tina.
